• Lifted iOS 26 Concentric Icon-Cushion Liquid Glass Dock: Elevated dock bottom margin (62px / 23.6dp) aligned with iOS 26 SpringBoard thumb elevation, uniform 4-sided ~40px icon cushion, smooth continuous curved corners (R_dock = 96px, p = 2.65), Page-0 wallpaper refraction crop & crisp 0.58dp 34° crystal specular rim
• Global Hidden Bottom Navigation Bar + Live Settings Toggle: Hides the bottom gesture pill globally across Home Screen, SystemUI & all apps by default while preserving 90Hz swipe gestures, with a live 'Show Bottom Navigation Bar' toggle in Settings -> Realme X2 Pro
• Zero User Data Loss & Locked 90Hz Smoothness Preserved: Home screen layout (launcher.db), Adreno 640 OpenGL ES 3.2 HWUI, Codec2 4K60/1080p60, Quad-Lens GCam 9.6, Unlimited Google Photos Backup & 50W SuperVOOC intact
